main.description: A Series the reader follows, or has dropped, in one Edition Line. One per Series: the record key is the Series' Catalog identifier.

series.description: Catalog identifier of the Series; equals the record key.

anchorIsbn.description: ISBN-13 of an Edition in the followed Edition Line. The Catalog derives the Edition Line (publisher, language, format) from it.

fromVolume.description: The Volume from which the reader collects this Edition Line, after a switch. Absent: from the first Volume.
